title.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center's support for COVID-19 vaccines

description.narrative: Limiting the spread of the novel coronavirus, supporting the health sector and its resilience in confronting the coronavirus, and enhancing health services in combating the spread of the coronavirus.
Providing COVID-19 vaccine doses and logistical services to the Republic of Tunisia to contribute to combating the coronavirus pandemic.

The resilience and continuity of the health sector in providing therapeutic and preventive services from health sector workers and citizens, educating citizens on how to deal with the pandemic and taking precautionary measures to limit the spread of the Coronavirus and reduce deaths.
